output_list.criticism: The function allows the owner to mint tokens without any checks, which can lead to uncontrolled token creation.
The function relies on the owner to set prices, which can be manipulated and lead to unpredictable outcomes.
The function allows the owner to burn tokens, which can lead to a denial of service attack if the balance is not checked.
The function allows the owner to buy tokens, which can lead to uncontrolled token distribution and potentially drain the contract.
The function allows the owner to sell tokens, which can lead to uncontrolled token distribution and potentially drain the contract.
